input.description: Telemetry shows oil pressure steadily falling from 35.7 psi to ~18 psi and then plateauing, while RPM (1600-1700) and coolant temp (~89°C) stay stable — this pattern (real engine parameters steady, oil pressure alone degrading and settling at a persistently low level) looks like genuine oil pressure loss, not a transient sensor glitch like the coolant-sensor calibration issue in KB-001/KB-002. The only KB entry for this symptom, KB-004, explicitly states low oil pressure warnings on this engine type are 'not resolved by sensor restart' and its documented fix is schedule_service_visit — which has already been rejected due to a 2-week service bay backlog. There is no disagreeing KB entry offering a valid remote alternative (restart_sensor is contraindicated by KB-004, and no KB entry supports send_diagnostic_reset for this symptom). Given persistent low oil pressure can risk engine damage, I recommend escalating to human support to arrange either an expedited/alternate service slot or a qualified technician to do an in-field oil level/pressure check, rather than attempting an unsupported remote fix.
